claims.claim: Repository pytest defaults to 12 workers, load distribution and zero restarts, with actual configuration and worker-completion checks.
V1 preserves authored commands and scope; prospective V2 bindings derive committed defaults and explicit pins while retaining historical decoding.
Collection-only executes zero workers, explicit diagnostic pins retain their counts, and the selected wrapper retains one collection followed by one 12-worker execution.
Windows pytest validates a direct installed Git executable, records its provenance, and provides process-local executable selection and isolated writable fixture state.
Prospective observation and reuse gates validate worker, Git, toolchain, observer, collection and subject bindings; raw evidence and observer outputs refuse overwrite.
Conflicting controls, missing capabilities, crashes, incomplete reports and shared fixture roots have explicit failure paths without worker retries.
Added real subprocess regressions covering 12-worker execution, collection, diagnostic pins, Git behavior and failures, crashes, binding mismatches and fixture isolation.
All changed files are within scope.modify; TASK-231 selection policy and historical TASK/RUN records remain unchanged.
